# Smartech Synergys

> Smartech Synergys provides IT support, computer repair, hardware upgrades, office device setup, custom PC builds, and on-site IT assistance across Kuala Lumpur and Selangor, Malaysia.

## Website

- [Official website](https://smartechsynergys.com/): Business information, services, coverage, frequently asked questions, and contact options.

## Services

- [Hardware and software repair](https://smartechsynergys.com/#services): Diagnosis and repair for PCs, laptops, smartphones, and operating-system issues.
- [PC upgrades and maintenance](https://smartechsynergys.com/#maintenance): RAM and SSD upgrades, servicing, cleaning, thermal maintenance, and performance optimisation.
- [Office PC and device setup](https://smartechsynergys.com/#services): Supply, configuration, and deployment of office-ready workstations and devices.
- [Custom PC builds](https://smartechsynergys.com/#services): Purpose-built computers for gaming, creative work, and professional workloads.
- [On-site IT support](https://smartechsynergys.com/#services): Troubleshooting, repairs, and setup assistance at business and residential premises.
- [Technology products](https://smartechsynergys.com/#products): New and pre-owned computers, monitors, smartphones, accessories, components, and peripherals.

## Service area and contact

- [Kuala Lumpur and Selangor coverage](https://smartechsynergys.com/#coverage): Service coverage information for the Klang Valley.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://smartechsynergys.com/#faq): Information about visits, availability, quotations, device supply, and upgrades.
- [Contact Smartech Synergys](https://smartechsynergys.com/#contact): Request a consultation or use the published phone, email, and WhatsApp links.
